barReferences.rule: lower-median displayed quality of the non-provisional cohort configurations at freeze (E192; headline bar)
lower-quartile displayed quality of the non-provisional cohort configurations at freeze (O34)
upper-quartile displayed quality of the non-provisional cohort configurations at freeze (O34)

anchorPolicy.populationRule: ranked configurations with complete cost evidence (exact cost, no AA missing- or declined-task marker) on every component of the workload at the freeze cutoff; on the main workload this is the admission reference panel
anchorPolicy.planRule: the same configurations at their displayed Plan cost: measured routes, owner assumptions of every kind and API-cost fallbacks alike, since each is scored in the Plan table (O13, O16) and a narrower panel would clip them
anchorPolicy.belowMinimum: anchors unavailable: configurations on that workload get no cost score (the main workload must meet the minimum)
anchorPolicy.lifetime: reference IDs and costs are frozen; a population or rule change is a new anchor version with an old/new bridge, and evidence lost after freezing never rebuilds an anchor

barPolicy.selectionMode: deterministic at anchor freeze, before any bar outcome is computed
barPolicy.populationRule: non-provisional ranked configurations with a displayed quality
barPolicy.order: displayed quality ascending, then configuration ID
barPolicy.position: lower quartile, lower median (the headline bar) and upper quartile, each the displayed quality at zero-based position floor((n - 1) * k / 4), k = 1, 2, 3 (O34)
barPolicy.reference: the displayed quality at each ladder position, frozen as a level; the configuration at that position is recorded for audit and competes like any other
barPolicy.emptyPopulation: fewer than two population configurations: no bar pinned; the bar is published as unavailable
barPolicy.ladderPopulation: fewer than four population configurations: only the headline bar is pinned, because the quartile positions would coincide with it (E215)
barPolicy.nonTautology: a frozen level is never a configuration, so no bar can return its setter by construction; whether a result compares alternatives is published per result (possibleQualifierN, E198)
barPolicy.lifetime: fixed for the anchor version; replaced only by a versioned re-freeze that publishes old- and new-bar results on the common evaluable panel
